photos.desc: The leg of Jeffrey Rowland two months after having been bitten by a brown recluse spider . The flesh in the area of the bite is necrotized and was removed a month later.
Loxosceles reclusa , brown recluse, with Stenocorus cinnamopterus, ID Confidence: 90
